subject: Payment failed: Invoice 4512 — VAT number required and retry plan
messages:
From: HelioMetrics Billing <finance@heliometrics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Invoice 4512 — payment declined (VAT mismatch?)

Hi Irene,

We received invoice 4512 this morning but the payment failed in Stripe when attempting to charge our corporate card. Stripe returned a decline with a 3DS/issuer note. Our finance team also flagged that the invoice lists EU VAT even though we provided a VAT number in the PO — the number on the invoice (GB999999973) doesn't match our company's EU VAT (FR123456789). Can you confirm whether you can reissue without VAT or if we should provide additional documentation?

Invoice: 4512
Amount: EUR 18,250.00
Company VAT (we submitted): FR123456789
Attachment: invoice_4512.pdf (copied for reference)

We need to clear this quickly — is there a secure way to update card details so we can retry the payment? Also concerned about potential chargeback as the cardholder is asking for confirmation before they attempt another charge.

Thanks,
Sylvie Lambert
Head of Finance — HelioMetrics
finance@heliometrics.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: HelioMetrics Billing <finance@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:31:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice 4512 — payment declined (VAT mismatch?)

Hi Sylvie,

Thanks for the heads up — sorry for the hassle. Two things here and a proposed plan: 

1) VAT: If HelioMetrics is VAT-registered in the EU and provided FR123456789, we can reissue the invoice with reverse-charge (no VAT) once we have the VAT confirmation (a screen shot of your VAT registration or the VIES validation output is fine). I can circulate a VAT-clean copy for your records as soon as we validate.

2) Payment retry: The Stripe decline looks like an issuer 3DS failure. We avoid collecting card numbers in email; I will send a Stripe-hosted secure card update link that posts directly to your billing portal (expires in 72 hours). If you'd prefer, we can also initiate a one-time invoice-payment retry from our side after you update the card.

Proposed next steps (ETA today):
- I will send secure card-update link and a clean reissued invoice draft (no VAT) for signature/records.
- Once you update card + confirm VAT docs, we'll re-run the payment within 24 hours and hold off on any automated dunning for 7 days.

Looping in Markus (billing ops) to confirm we can pause automated retries and to approve a one-time manual retry if needed.

Warmly,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1-415-555-0102

Irene — thanks. Quick internal note: 

- We can pause the dunning job for HelioMetrics today and disable the 72-hour automated retry.
- One-time manual retry: ops is fine with a single manual charge after the card is updated, provided we have the customer's explicit sign-off (Sylvie's note is fine).
- Credits: given the amount, I don't recommend issuing a credit proactively. If the customer requests a one-time courtesy credit we should route to finance and sales (Ben) for approval.

Ben — FYI in case HelioMetrics pushes for credit/discount because of the checkout friction.

-Markus
Director, Billing Operations

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the plan. We'll upload the VIES confirmation (attached as screenshot) and proceed with a card update. A couple of clarifying Qs before we go ahead: 
- If the bank declines again on 3DS, does Redwood support bank-initiated retry or is it strictly cardholder re-authorization? We want to avoid multiple attempts that look like fraud to the issuer.
- Can you confirm that reissued invoice will show net EUR 18,250 and no VAT if VIES validates?
- What is Redwood's process if the cardholder disputes the charge (i.e., chargeback)? Do you provide evidence packages (SaaS platforms often have specific items to include)?

We attached payment-failure-screenshot.png showing the Stripe decline code. Please send the secure link and the draft invoice.

Best,
Sylvie

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: HelioMetrics Billing <finance@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 16:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice 4512 — payment declined (VAT mismatch?)

Sylvie — thanks, and really appreciate the quick turnaround. Finalizing plan below so it's explicit: 

1) Secure card update link (Stripe-hosted): https://pay.redwood.com/update-card?inv=4512 (expires in 72 hrs). Please have your cardholder update by EOD Aug 6 to avoid next dunning step.

2) VAT: Once we receive your VIES confirmation (or official VAT cert), we'll reissue invoice 4512 showing net EUR 18,250 with a note: "Reverse-charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer." Draft will arrive within 2 hours.

3) Retry and chargebacks: We will NOT run automated retries while we wait for your update. After card update and VAT validation, Ops (Markus) will do a single manual retry with your approval. If a chargeback happens, Redwood provides a standard evidence package for SaaS subscriptions (invoice, service records, API call logs referencing account id, signed TOS). We'll work with you to supply any additional info the bank needs.

4) If you'd like written confirmation for your cardholder to avoid issuer rejection, I can provide a short cover email they can show to their bank.

Attachments I'll send in follow-up: reissued_invoice_4512-no-vat.pdf (draft) and the secure link email (so the link originates from Stripe for PCI reasons).

Deadline: please update card + upload VAT doc by 2025-08-06 17:00 CEST. If you need a different timeline let me know.

Cheers,
Irene
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
